title: Application Load Balancer (path-based-route) to AWS Lambda
description: Create an Application Load Balancer with path-based routing using AWS Lambda as target

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern shows how to create an Application Load Balancer with path-based routing along with associated listener and target as AWS Lambda. Implemented in Terraform.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
